lesson: Initialized symfony-hermes-audit with baseline Symfony Best Practices and initial crystallized NoGetInControllerRule.
Captured Pattern #HE-002 (In-memory array slicing vs QueryBuilder::setMaxResults) and Pattern #HE-003 (Iterative EntityManager::flush in loops) from trivial-symfony audit.

Human review calibrated tribunal: 1) Eliminated false critical on @ for stream_socket_accept (timeout warnings crash in debug mode); 2) Restored Doctrine getRepository as valid standard, demoted to minor clean-code suggestion; 3) Restricted Yoda style strictly to equality (==, !=, ===, !==), banned < and > transformations; 4) Eliminated false positive XSS on Twig {% set %} buffers with |raw; 5) Separated route methods hygiene from controller invokable refactoring; 6) Enforced verbatim docs quoting without paraphrasing.
